prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Path Mascot Showcase Split View: Redesigns the path selection step into a split layout view featuring a friendly mascot guide to assist users in selecting their onboarding path.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "text": "I'll guide you through choosing your new companion path!", "style": "playful"}]}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Status Hint: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users that their existing pets will automatically restore.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing into your existing account automatically restores all previously created pets and companion data."}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Bond Selection Screen: Inserts a brand-new screen 'new_pet_bond' right before the adoption certificate step to let users choose their pet's core temperament.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_bond", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"headline": "Select Companion Demeanor and Personality"}}
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness Countdown and Diagnostic Indicator: Replaces the waiting status screen with real-time system progress indicators and countdown timers while the desktop pet spawns.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "replace": {"wait_status": [{"role": "wait_status", "type": "progress", "text": "Verifying desktop overlay compatibility and spawning pet graphics...", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
4: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Card Layout: Redesigns the final intro screen into a clear grid card layout outlining core desktop controls, tray icons, and shortcut hotkeys.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Quickly learn how to position, chat with, or hide your companion anytime.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Right-click pet for quick menu; Drag to place anywhere; Double-click to chat", "style": "rounded"}]}}
5: [choose_path, copy] Fast Track Companion Path Copy: Updates headline and button text on the choose path screen to clarify setup duration between instant companion selection and custom design.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Setup Speed", "body": "Choose Instant Adoption to launch in 30 seconds or Custom Pet to design from scratch.", "button_label": "Continue Setup"}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Starter Accessory Unlock Badge Banner: Displays an unlocked bonus reward badge on photo upload and adoption screens to incentivize setup completion.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Bonus Starter Accessory Pack Unlocked!", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [sign_in, new_flow] One-Click Quick Session Account Flow: Rebuilds sign-in choices into interactive choice cards for instant guest mode vs quick account creation.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "choice_cards", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"role": "sign_in_options", "type": "choice_cards", "text": "Choose Fast Guest Start or Sync Account to Save Pet Progress", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
8: [home, notification] Background Spawning Desktop Ready Sound Alert: Adds an optional sound chime and system notification toggle to alert users when pet initialization completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Play Chime When Desktop Ready", "action": "play"}]}}
9: [finish, hint] Tray Menu and Desktop Visibility Hint: Adds a hint on the finish screen explaining system tray controls and keyboard shortcuts for pet visibility.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: You can hide or summon your pet anytime from the system tray menu or by pressing Ctrl+Shift+P."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the path selection layout while preserving both adopting and creating paths.
Adds an explanatory hint to sign-in without altering features or pricing.
Changes the core job of pick_friend from choosing a pet companion to selecting demeanor.
Adds progress indicators for a real wait time during pet generation.
Redesigns home_intro into a grid layout while preserving pet interaction instructions.
Updates choose_path copy while retaining both instant adoption and custom pet options.
Mentions a bonus starter accessory unlock, violating the rule against mentioning gifts or extras in copy.
Offers a guest mode option that makes sign-in skippable.
Adds an optional sound notification to the waiting screen without breaking rules.
Adds an informational shortcut hint to home_intro.
